incentives.name: Data center sales and use tax exemption
incentives.what: Sales/use tax exemption on qualified data center equipment and electricity for up to 50 years; IEDC sets terms per project (e.g. 35 years for $800M+ investment, +5 years per extra $800M, up to 50). Local governments can add property tax abatements (up to 10 years real, 20 years personal property).
incentives.value_known: Citizens Action Coalition reports the state granted $655 million in data center sales tax exemptions in 2025 (advocacy group figure).

laws_and_bills.name: HEA 1007 (2025)
laws_and_bills.what: Speeds IURC approval of new power plants to serve large loads such as data centers and sets short decision timelines; whether it makes data centers pay most new plant costs is disputed (per Citizens Action Coalition).

dockets.what: Costs (more than $400M per CAC) to connect the Google Fort Wayne and AWS New Carlisle data centers.
Transmission plan update including $216M of network upgrades for the Meta Jeffersonville data center (per CAC).
Amazon large-load contract (2,400 MW, reportedly raised to 2,800 MW; can drop to 1,200 MW if Amazon notifies by early 2029), tied to NIPSCO GenCo gas generation.
I&M large-load case cited by CAC for data center tariff workpapers.

local_rules.what: Moratorium on new data center applications through 2027; three already-approved sites (incl. DC BLOX) may continue.
Special zoning class for data centers (siting, home setbacks, noise, annual energy/water/noise/generator reports; no use variances). MDC recommended 5-3 on July 1, 2026; council vote expected August.
County Council voted 6-3 to direct the Area Plan Commission to amend zoning to prohibit new hyperscale data centers (not affecting Microsoft Granger or AWS New Carlisle).
local_rules.status: in process; final vote expected about 60 days later

local_rules.what: Proposed ordinance suspending new data center approvals until zoning rules are added or July 31, 2028; excludes Google's Project Maize.
Data center overlay district: requires Industrial General zoning and commissioner sign-off for data centers.
local_rules.status: adopted (referred to as the county's new overlay ordinance in Aug 2026)

local_rules.what: Area Plan Commission adopted a countywide data center zoning ordinance Oct 1-2, 2026; goes to commissioners. Residents had asked for a two-year moratorium.
Commissioners scheduled a vote on a 180-day deferral ordinance for data centers amid Project Zora.
County data center ordinance covering noise, setbacks, power availability, efficiency, water management plans and decommissioning.
Outright ban on data center construction (one of 3 Indiana counties with bans; 24 counties have temporary moratoria and 13 have data center ordinances, per IU Environmental Resilience Institute).
Commissioners denied a 715-acre rezoning for a DataOne data center 3-0 on Jan 20, 2026; a 12-month wait applies.
